title: Fix FileMemoryStore silent corruption skip + SanitizeId too narrow
description:
## Source
Audit swarm finding F-AG2-02 / F-002 (memorysmith-codebase-audit-26-07-11-03-39-33)

## Problem
`FileMemoryStore.LoadAll()` catches all exceptions silently when encountering corrupt files — corrupt entries are silently dropped with no warning or count. `SanitizeId()` uses a regex that's too narrow, potentially allowing problematic characters.

## Severity
High

## Files
- `MemorySmith.Core/Storage/FileMemoryStore.cs`

## Recommendation
Replace silent skip with counted failure path (log warning + increment corrupt-file counter). Use `Path.GetInvalidFileNameChars()` for broader sanitization.

## Existing Coverage
No existing task.
